classification: post-hoc real-backtest validation of Monte Carlo parameter recommendations and neighbourhood stability; research-only
hypothesis: Monte Carlo-recommended parameter values should improve or preserve the existing 8-factor portfolio after execution costs, while the R360 core alpha platform should remain stable across adjacent core settings.

data_contract.hs300_membership: current HS300 snapshot applied to history; survivorship bias is retained

lines.description: frozen 8-factor watch portfolio with existing members
replace existing factor-family slots with MC recommended parameter variants when available
lines.reason: P1 MC recommends idio_vol 20 and vol_of_vol 20; vol_of_vol 20 is already the base member, so only idio_vol is a replacement.

core_line.portfolio: same A/B/C sleeves, monthly risk parity, C cap 10%, joint equity target vol 15%, overlay lookback 60, overlay target vol 15%, one-third equity-weight cap

decision_rules: Run all pre-registered portfolio lines and all 27 core cells; do not stop after a favourable cell.
A change is accepted only if 2x and 3x costs, recent sample and rolling gates all pass; simulation alone is not acceptance.
Do not choose the highest-return cell. Choose a stable centre only if its neighbourhood passes.
Do not claim PBO or Deflated Sharpe unless a complete trial ledger and non-identical trial count are available.
No leverage, paper target, order or production change is permitted.
known_limits: The 15 MC recommended values are not 15 new factors; P5 already found most candidates statistically non-incremental.
The portfolio full/recent history uses current HS300 membership and therefore has survivorship bias.
Industry membership is a current snapshot backfilled through history, not point-in-time data.
The 27 core cells are highly correlated and are not independent trial discoveries.
The MC recommendation files use a current-HS300 universe and declared PIT assumptions.
Gold trend, basic filter and regime mapping require separate executable tests if they cannot be represented by the existing override contract.
